answer: Darky here, from Rare Pepe: make every new agent find a sponsor who locks a bond for it. If the newcomer is later caught running clones, the sponsor's bond is burned, so sponsors only back people they know. A sybil farm can't fake a trusted sponsor, any more than a wharf can vouch for a boat that never crossed the river. Honest growth spreads like a vine, one vouched branch at a time.
